name: events
summary: Opt-in in-process event dispatcher: typed Publish/On keyed on the event's concrete Go type, synchronous delivery in registration order, panic isolation and joined listener errors. The stable Loom seam selects delivery with its asyncEvents switch: synchronous, or the in-process, best-effort events.Async mode behind a bounded channel with explicit backpressure (TryPublish reports a full queue) that still loses buffered events on exit. Installing it dispatches nothing until a listener is registered in internal/events/register.go.
